definitions.explanation: The general opinion held about someone or something; what is said about them.

examples.japanese: このレストランは{評判|ひょうばん}がいい。
examples.english: This restaurant has a good reputation.

examples.japanese: {評判|ひょうばん}の{新|あたら}しい{映画|えいが}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see the new movie that everyone is talking about.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{評判|ひょうばん}は{会社|かいしゃ}{中|じゅう}に{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: His reputation spread throughout the company.

notes:
USAGE: {評判|ひょうばん} can be used for both good and bad reputations. The context usually makes clear which is meant.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{評判|ひょうばん}がいい/わるい (good/bad reputation)
・{評判|ひょうばん}になる (to become popular/famous)
・{評判|ひょうばん}を{落|お}とす (to damage one's reputation)
・{評判|ひょうばん}の〜 (the well-known ~)
・{評判|ひょうばん}を{聞|き}く (to hear about someone's reputation)
